svg.title: Figure 4. The Giant Fiber route, and the best route left without it
svg.desc: Figure 4. Top: in the intact type graph the strongest route runs LPLC2, the looming detector, to DNp01, the Giant Fiber, with 4,862 synapses carrying 2.7% of LPLC2's output, then to TTMn, the jump motor neuron, with 90 synapses carrying 3.6% of DNp01's output: 2 hops, output-share product 9.45 × 10⁻⁴. Bottom: with DNp01 removed the best route runs LPLC2 to DNp103 to IN07B054 to IN21A027 to TTMn, with 5,065, 402, 75 and 313 synapses: 4 hops, product 4.92 × 10⁻⁶. A structural result, not a behavioral one.
